newsitem.title: USA: NatWest hires McManus as U.S. strategist.
newsitem.headline: NatWest hires McManus as U.S. strategist.

text.p: NatWest Markets said it hired Thomas McManus as U.S. strategist and senior vice president responsible for U.S. investment strategy.
McManus was most recently investment strategist in the equity research division at Morgan Stanley Group Inc.

McManus will report directly to Edmond Warner, who will join NatWest's London office in April as global head of research and global strategist from Dresdner Bank AG unit Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, and Michael Hanley, head of research for North America.
Natwest Markets is the corporate and investment banking arm of NatWest Group, a unit of National Westminster Bank Plc.
